sentences.text:
As per the prosecution story, on 24.06.2019, around 40 women from Wa r d No.11,
Khaskhaswadi, Khargone came and submitted a complaint alleging that the present applicant misrepresented to them and allegedly told them about a scheme/ yojana administered by Prime Minister.
On the basis of which they would receive Rs.2,000/- support money from the Government.
On the basis of said information, the applicant took their identity cards, documents and thumbprints on some paper and by using that took a loan of around Rs.30 lakhs in their name.
It is also alleged that the applicant fraudulently got these complainant's thumbprints and took out all loan money and gave them Rs.2,000/- each.
Applicant also allegedly keep paying few installments in these complainant's bank account and that afterwards stopped paying installments.
Accordingly, a case has been registered against the applicant.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent person and she has been falsely implicated in this matter.
Applicant is in jail since 30.09.2019, meaning thereby, she has suffered jail incarceration for a period of about 3 years and 10 months.

Although in the earlier order,
it has been mentioned that prosecutrix has examined only 20 witnesses, but it is not factually correct.
Prosecutrix has examined only two witnesses in the last four years.
Applicant is a 35 years old lady.
She has ailing father.
She is the only care taker of her father.
Applicant herself suffering from several medical ailments.
Her proper treatment is not possible inside the jail.
She is a permanent resident of District Khargone.
Final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Under the above circumstances, prayer for grant of bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.

6. Per-contra, learned counsel for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection by submitting that applicant's earlier bail application was dismissed on merit after considering all the facts and circumstances of the case.
Hence, she does not deserve for bail.

7. Perused the case diary as well as the impugned order of the court below.
8 .

Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, nature and gravity of allegation as also taking note of the fact that although applicant's earlier bail application was dismissed on merit, but it is wrong factual that prosecutrix has examined 20 witnesses; as per report, prosecutrix has examined only two witnesses in the last four years;
applicant has already suffered jail incarceration since September, 2019; she is not having any criminal past and final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.

In view of the above,
delay in trial, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

9. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for her appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

She shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S. 437(3) Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
